    if i+1>=len(f):return dict(valid=False,reason='no_entry_bar')

    protection=stop;peak=0.;armed=False

    clocks=f.index+r.HOUR;n=len(f);auditcounts['source_bars']+=n

    iname=job['instrument']; local=sig[sig.instrument.eq(iname)]; labels=lab[lab.instrument.eq(iname)]
    union=set()

     for stage in ('early','confirmed'):

import json,hashlib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from yoyo.evaluation import spike_burst_v3_density_rearm_report as r
p,v,refs=r.authenticate('21d971a27363f225bb7451c310a9e5d5cd5554e1f6f36006eff1bf3a04286704')
def read(name):return pd.read_csv(r.required(r.OUT/name,refs),float_precision='round_trip')
labs=read('labels.csv.gz');labs.decision_time=pd.to_datetime(labs.decision_time,utc=True)
det=read('detections.csv.gz')
d0=det[det.arm.eq('v3')&det.stage.eq('early')].set_index(['instrument','event_i'])
d1=det[det.arm.eq('density_rearm')&det.stage.eq('early')].set_index(['instrument','event_i'])
pos=labs[labs.label.eq('positive')&labs.decision_time.ge(r.START)&labs.decision_time.lt(r.END)].set_index(['instrument','event_i'])
miss=pos[d0.loc[pos.index].hit_1 & ~d1.loc[pos.index].hit_1].reset_index()
matching=json.loads(r.required(r.OUT/'matching.json',refs).read_text())
out=[]
for job,item in zip(matching['jobs'],matching['state_artifacts']):
    local=miss[miss.instrument.eq(job['instrument'])]
    if local.empty:continue
    st=pd.read_csv(r.checked(item['path'],item['sha256'],refs),float_precision='round_trip')
    for a in local.itertuples():
        i=int(a.event_i+d0.loc[(a.instrument,a.event_i),'first_signal_lag'])
        z=st.iloc[i];owner=z.density_rearm_structure_owner_before_i
        assert z.v3_early and not z.density_rearm_early
        if pd.notna(owner):assert st.density_rearm_early.iloc[int(owner)]
        out.append(dict(instrument=a.instrument,anchor_i=a.event_i,original_v3_i=i,large=bool(a.large_peak),
          original_close_time=z.decision_time,reason=z.density_rearm_reject_reason,
          quota_blocked=bool(z.density_rearm_structure_blocked),cooldown_blocked=bool(z.density_rearm_cooldown_blocked),
          owner_i=owner,owner_age=i-owner if pd.notna(owner) else np.nan,density_valid=bool(z.density_rearm_density_valid)))
m=pd.DataFrame(out);assert len(m)==603
reasons=m.groupby('reason').agg(missed_anchors=('anchor_i','size'),large=('large','sum'),median_owner_age=('owner_age','median'),max_owner_age=('owner_age','max')).reset_index()
figures={}
for name in ['hype','near','pepe']:
    path=r.OUT/'g_report_figures'/f'{name}_96h.png'
